card.name: Counts of events in trial reports
card.fires_on: The word right after the subject of a reported event, such as 'were', 'died', 'patients' or 'cancer', where a count or number comes next. Mostly in clinical trial adverse-event text, and also in historical statistics.

modes.label: Trial event reports
modes.description: Verb or noun after a subject in trial results, just before a number of cases or patients.
modes.example: 3 patients on galantamine (n=1,026) and 1 patient on placebo (n=1,022)<< died>>. The deaths were due to various causes

modes.label: Historical and statistical prose
modes.description: Verbs or table separators in history or economic trend text, just before a date or figure.
modes.example: President Herbert Hoover had engaged in a massive stimulus spending program that came close to bankrupting state and local governments as the economy<< continued>> to spiral downward 1929
